Trusted by teams at
Today’s business interview only shows how well people
talk about work
Every candidate says they use AI every day, and a conversation cannot show you how
Each interviewer asks different questions, so candidates for the same role are hard to compare
Panel notes describe impressions, not the work the candidate did
Run the interview around a real task
Choose a task from the job
Pick a business task from the Codility library for sales, marketing, finance, operations or customer roles. Each task asks for a real deliverable, such as a customer reply to write or a report to check.
Watch them work with the AI Assistant
You see each prompt as the candidate sends it and can ask why they asked it and what they changed. Every prompt is saved.
Talk it through face to face
Video and a whiteboard are part of every session. Ask the candidate to explain their approach, test their assumptions and sketch how they would handle a harder version of the task.
Rate against one rubric
Interviewers rate each skill against a shared rubric and add a note to every rating. Integrity signals remain available for human review. The report keeps the deliverable, every prompt and the ratings together for the hiring team.
